source.method: Curated evidence fusion: Wicklow County Council parking by-laws/current parking guidance + OpenStreetMap-derived location evidence + current parking listings + aerial/street imagery review.
source.caveat: Physical parking evidence and legal parking rules are not live occupancy. On-site signage takes precedence.

locations.name: North Beach Car Park
locations.pricing_raw: Wicklow County Council Zone H: €0.30/hour; €3 all day; pay-control 07:30–18:30; free all day Sunday. Verify current on-site signage.
locations.source_notes: Official by-laws name North Beach Carpark. Current mapping/listing evidence places the seafront car park around 53.20648,-6.10027. Nearby 'Bray Town Council Car Park'/'Northern Carpark' listings are treated as aliases/adjacent evidence, not separate canonical assets.

evidence.note: Wicklow County Council states the 2017 county parking by-laws cover Bray.
Schedule A Zone H names North Beach Carpark and sets the listed charge/control period.

locations.name: Strand Road Seafront Parking Corridor
locations.pricing_raw: Wicklow County Council Zone D: €0.30/hour or €3/day; up to 15 hours unless an information plate states otherwise; free all day Sunday. Verify current signage and event restrictions.
locations.source_notes: Official by-laws cover Strand Road from Martello Terrace to Fontenoy Terrace. Aerial/street imagery shows sustained parking use along the seafront, but bay-by-bay geometry and present capacity are not asserted from historical imagery.
locations.restriction_notes: Special-event traffic management can temporarily prohibit Strand Road parking; live/event signage overrides the baseline.

evidence.note: Schedule A Zone D includes Strand Road from Martello Terrace to Fontenoy Terrace.
2017 aerial imagery of Bray beachfront visibly shows a continuous row of parked cars; used only as physical-supply evidence, not current occupancy.
Geotagged Strand Road image at approximately 53.20481,-6.09960 shows marked/used roadside parking.
2026 Air Display traffic plan demonstrates temporary no-parking closures can supersede baseline rules.

locations.name: Bray Station Car Park (Station Yard)
locations.opening_hours_raw: 24-hour access reported by current parking listings; verify operator signage.
locations.source_notes: OSM-derived parking geometry identifies a Station Yard parking area adjacent to Bray (Daly).

locations.name: Bray (Daly) Station Car Park 2 / NCPS
locations.opening_hours_raw: 24-hour access reported by current parking listings; verify operator signage.
locations.source_notes: Two current listings resolve to effectively the same Quinsborough Road coordinates; canonicalised as one asset to avoid double counting.

locations.name: Florence Road Car Park
locations.pricing_raw: Wicklow County Council Zone G: €1/hour; €5 all day; pay-control 07:30–18:30; free all day Sunday. Verify current on-site signage.
locations.opening_hours_raw: 24-hour access is reported by a current listing; pay-control hours are separately defined by the council by-laws.
locations.source_notes: Official by-laws name Florence Road Carpark; current location listing provides coordinates.

evidence.note: Zone G names Florence Road Carpark and lists tariff/control hours.

locations.name: Dargle Car Park
locations.pricing_raw: Secondary listing: €1/hour; €10 daily max; €5 daily max with validation. Verify operator signage before use.
locations.opening_hours_raw: 24-hour access reported by current parking listing.
locations.source_notes: OSM-derived geometry and a current parking listing corroborate a surface car park on Seapoint Road. Capacity/pricing are secondary-source fields and should not be treated as council-authoritative.

evidence.note: Secondary listing reports 48 spaces, 2 accessible spaces and current tariff details.

locations.name: Bray Head / Raheen Park Car Park
locations.source_notes: Mapped south-seafront/Bray Head parking location. Access/rules remain unverified, so WHITEBLOCK keeps access as unknown rather than assuming public eligibility.

candidates.name: Additional Bray seafront bay-level inventory
candidates.evidence_note: Historical aerial imagery and present-day visual observation indicate substantially more bay-level supply than current structured datasets expose. Do not publish a capacity total until fresh imagery/field verification and sign-by-sign rule capture are complete.
